_note: B-35. Provisioning PowerShell lever over the offline mock tenant (fixtures/tenant/<client>.json and <client>/mailboxes.json). user.new is R3 with two distinct lead approvals and the requester+contact verification, like user.new-tap. The Graph permission in graph_scopes is UNVERIFIED. It has no registered undo: user.disable stops the account but does not remove it, so it is not offered as an undo. Mock only; no real tenant is called.

levers.name: user.new
levers.description: Create one member user and its mailbox record for a new hire: enabled, with no credential and no license. The first sign-in is a separate approved step (user.new-tap). The same upn with the same values changes nothing; the same upn with different values is refused. Mock of a Graph user create.

display_name.description: Display name from the new-hire form

job_title.description: Job title from the new-hire form

manager_upn.description: userPrincipalName of the manager; must already be a user of this client

impact.L1: A new hire gets an account that can sign in on day one once the pass is issued; a wrong name, title or manager follows them into mail, approvals and group rules until it is fixed.
impact.L2: The client gets a working account for a named person; an account made for an impostor is a way into the client's data, so the request must come from the client's own authorized contact.
impact.L3: Joiners get one checked plan with two lead approvals instead of six admin screens; the audit holds no secret and the account has no credential until the pass step.
impact.L4: Every client's joiners go through the same checked path, and an account is never created from free text or on one person's say-so.
